subject: ddl: add states to remove old objects during modifying column (#62549)
summary: Adds a post-reorg modify-column-with-data cleanup phase that tombstones old column/index objects (WriteOnly→DeleteOnly→remove) after the new column becomes Public, plus related job-args/infoschema/SHOW CREATE robustness changes. Reviewed later upstream/master history for any introduced high-risk edge cases; follow-up fixes exist, leaving no remaining Blocker/High issues in the reviewed scope.
